user.title: Connect to gSender
user.description: Enable Remote Mode in gSender (Config -> Remote Mode) first and enter the IP/port shown there. The controller port must match exactly what gSender's main app connects to: a serial path like /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM3 for USB, or the controller's IP address (e.g. 192.168.5.1) for Ethernet boards like the SLB-EXT.

data.host: Host / IP address of the gSender PC
data.serial_port: Controller port (serial path or controller IP)
data.network: Controller is connected over Ethernet/network (e.g. SLB-EXT)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure gSender
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details. Useful when the gSender PC got a new IP address or the CNC moved to a different port.
